$comment: The database versions proxy-monster supports, and the container image each version is tested
against. This file is the ONE place the set is declared: the CI matrix generates its legs from
it, and DbSupportMatrixTest fails the build if the engine's bundled classification manifests and
this file disagree in either direction. Adding a version means editing this file, adding the
'target' engines are the databases the proxy brokers queries TO. Every target series needs a
bundled system-classification manifest, because the classifier's system-catalog and
'storage' engines are what the control-plane keeps its own state in. PostgreSQL only: the store
SQL uses RETURNING, ON CONFLICT, jsonb and :: casts.
Series is the granularity support is claimed at (PostgreSQL major, MySQL major.minor); the image
tag is a floating pin within that series, so a patch release is picked up without touching this
file. A test asserts the live server's series matches the image it was configured with, so a
matrix leg cannot silently run against the wrong version.
